regions.today: Bright spells and well scattered showers this evening. Winds gradually easing.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be mainly dry with clear spells. Lowest temperatures of 4 to 9 degrees with light southerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Tomorrow, Monday, will be dry and bright with long spells of sunshine, hazy at times. Highest temperatures of 14 to 17 degrees in mostly light to moderate south to southeast winds.
